platform: Cloud-first SaaS and browser-based platform with native iOS and Android apps; no desktop client or on-premise deployment documented.

distinctive_features.feature: Integrated ERP, LMS, assessment, and board-aligned content stack.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Connects administration, teaching, assessment, and learning content within one product family.

distinctive_features.feature: Adaptive assessments using Item Response Theory and Knowledge Space Theory claims.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Can adjust question difficulty and provide concept-level learning analytics.

distinctive_features.feature: AI-proctored exams and automated question-paper generation.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Supports exam delivery and creation across online, offline, and hybrid workflows.
Combines face verification and geofencing without requiring external biometric terminals.
Enables traceable, pre-funded purchases for school fees, events, activities, and supplies.

distinctive_features.feature: NFC transport attendance using an attendant’s phone.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Records student boarding while GPS and alerts inform parents about journeys.

distinctive_features.feature: White-labelled role-based mobile app and website.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Allows schools to provide branded digital access for families and staff.

distinctive_features.feature: Large India-oriented content and question bank claims.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Offers board-mapped content and a broad question bank for varied assessment needs.

weaknesses.issue: Public module-by-module pricing, implementation SLA, and premium-tier details are unavailable; published price ranges are broad.
Independent reviews cite lengthy setup and training.
Independent feedback cites weak reporting and limited integration options.
App reviews report key-expiry problems, slow loading, frozen video, audio issues, and missing homework.
App-store privacy disclosures conflict; public materials do not establish DPDP readiness or retention and deletion controls.
Public materials do not document UDISE+ or APAAR reporting, GST invoicing, or higher-education statutory reporting.
Hostel workflows are listed but not sufficiently described in reviewed public materials.

ai_features: Adaptive assessments using Item Response Theory and Knowledge Space Theory claims
AI-powered doubt or learning assistance claims; production scope is not documented
pricing_model_summary: Modular, quote-based pricing; official pages give indicative ranges of ₹7–₹155 per student monthly for ERP packages and ₹20–₹50 for LMS. No public rate card or USD pricing.
biggest_strategic_gap: Limited public evidence for open APIs, statutory reporting, formal security certifications, and data-lifecycle controls may complicate integration and compliance validation.
